trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Blockade
trends.summary: Iran continues restricting oil tanker transit through Strait of Hormuz to ~15 vessels/day despite ceasefire, with only 55% probability of normalization before July 1. Trump administration escalating rhetoric while US military assets (USS Bush, Ford, Boxer) converge on region, suggesting possible ground offensive preparation. This sustained supply disruption is reshaping energy markets and monetary policy calculations.

trends.name: China-Taiwan Unification Push
trends.summary: Xi Jinping told Taiwan opposition leader that unification is an 'inevitability' in first cross-strait opposition talks in a decade, rejecting Taiwan independence and external interference. Polymarket shows 90% probability of diplomatic meeting by April 15. This represents significant geopolitical escalation with major implications for semiconductor supply chains and US-China relations.

trends.name: Record M&A Activity Surge
trends.summary: Global M&A transaction values jumped +18% YoY in Q1 2026 to $1.25 trillion, the largest Q1 total on record, including Unilever's $44.8B food business sale to McCormick and Sysco's $29.1B deal. Strong insider buying (26.4% of companies with net purchases) suggests institutional confidence despite Iran war concerns, signaling robust dealmaking environment ahead.

trends.name: AI Chip Demand Sustains Growth
trends.summary: TSMC posts 35% revenue jump to record high driven by sustained AI chip demand, while OpenAI and Anthropic compete fiercely with Anthropic gaining momentum. Alibaba invests $290M in new LLM model development as industry grapples with current model limitations. AI infrastructure investment remains a primary growth driver for tech sector despite competitive intensity.

trends.name: Fed Policy Path Amid Stagflation Risk
trends.summary: Global PMI data shows stagflation risks as output growth slumps amid surging prices, complicating Fed's next moves following payroll surprises. Energy market volatility is reshaping monetary policy calculations. Kevin Warsh's Fed chair confirmation hearing delayed, creating uncertainty around policy direction during period of elevated geopolitical and inflationary pressures.

trends.name: Energy Market Volatility Reshapes Strategy
trends.summary: Oil prices supported by ongoing supply risks and geopolitical tensions, with real-world oil price indicators revealing elevated stress in energy markets. EU importing more Russian gas as Middle East crisis squeezes supplies. Energy market swings are driving sector rotation and influencing inflation expectations, creating both risks and opportunities in commodity and energy stocks.

trends.name: Food Inflation & Agricultural Commodities
trends.summary: Iran geopolitical crisis threatens to trigger food inflation spike, with investors urged to counter through strategic positioning. China's factory prices return to growth after 3 years, beating expectations on surging oil prices, while Eli Lilly loses market share to generic weight-loss drugs in India. Agricultural and food commodity costs are becoming key investor concern amid supply chain pressures.

trends.name: Tech Layoffs & Efficiency Drives
trends.summary: Oracle's aggressive layoffs tied to $4B return threshold investors cannot ignore, signaling broader tech sector focus on profitability over growth. This reflects shifting priorities amid AI competition and market maturation, with major implications for tech valuations and sector composition going forward.

trends.name: EU Tech Regulation & Fines Surge
trends.summary: Trump administration escalating anger as EU Big Tech fines exceed $7 billion in 2 years, creating trade tensions and regulatory uncertainty. This represents growing friction between US tech giants and European regulators, with implications for global tech stocks and US-EU relations.

trends.name: Precious Metals & Rare Earths Supply
trends.summary: Hecla Mining positioned for growth as silver market remains undersupplied, while rare earths funding boom could cause longer-term glut concerns. Supply-demand dynamics in precious and rare earth metals are creating investment opportunities amid geopolitical and manufacturing shifts.

trends.name: Dividend Stocks & BDC Valuations
trends.summary: BCP Investment offers well-covered dividend yield amid tender offer/buyout speculation, while Ares Capital versus Blackstone Secured Lending trade quality versus yield. Banks like Lake Shore Bancorp showing compelling valuations post-recent gains. Dividend and fixed-income strategies gaining investor attention amid rate uncertainty and market volatility.

trends.name: Geopolitical Premium & Market Timing
trends.summary: Investors debate whether ceasefire-driven rally has pushed stocks too high too quickly, with market strategists warning 'we're not going back to pre-war environment.' Insider purchases remain strong despite Iran war concerns, suggesting mixed sentiment on sustainability of gains. Geopolitical risk premium will likely persist and shape market direction through 2026.
